name: rembric
description: Memory for Claude Code, backed by your self-hosted Rembric server.

server_url.title: Rembric server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Rembric deployment WITHOUT the /mcp suffix. Good: https://memory.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8787. Bad: https://memory.example.com/mcp (the plugin appends /mcp itself). No trailing slash.

api_token.title: Rembric API token
api_token.description: Bearer token issued from the Rembric dashboard at /dashboard/tokens (plaintext shown exactly once). Stored in the system keychain.
